title: 航空構造設計(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Aircraft Structure Design
keywords: Stress and strain 2.Torsion, bending, and tension 3.Buckling 4.Stiffened plate 5.Composite material
educationalGoal: Students will learn (1) relationship between stress and strain of 3D elastic body (2) slender bar under torsional, bending, and tensile load (3) buckling of long column and thin flat plate (4) the concept of effective width flat plate with stiffeners (5) mechanics of composite laminate
advice: On the basis of knowledge learned in subjects such as ‘Mechanics of Materials’ and ‘Mechanics of Aircraft Structure’, student will learn the advanced mechanics for aircraft structural design. We will cover the following materials: (1) Relationship between stress and strain of 3D elastic body (2) Stress of bar under combination of torsional, bending, and tensile load (3) Stress of short column under eccentric compression load (4) Buckling of long column and flat plate (5) Buckling and effective width of plate with stiffeners (6) Mechanics of composite laminate Students should thoroughly review what they have learned in ‘Mechanics of Materials’ and ‘Mechanics of Aircraft Structure’ before taking this course.
books: Basis of Understanding Strength of Materials -Second Edition, Kyoritsu Syuppan, 2013
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of Mechanics of Materials and Mechanics of Aircraft Structure

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the relationship between stresses and strains of 3D elastic body
Be able to calculate the maximum principal stress of the bar under both torsional and tensile loads
Be able to calculate the core of section of a short column under eccentric compression load
Be able to calculate the buckling load of long column and plat plate
Be able to understand the concept of effective width and calculate the effective width of plate with stiffener
Be able to calculate the stiffness matrix of composite laminates and explain the mechanical behavior
